# Anmol Graphics - Full Technical Specifications & Catalog

Anmol Graphics is a premier Indian manufacturer and supplier of identity management products, smart cards, customized neck lanyards, and accessories.

## 1. Product Categories & Technical Specifications

### A. PVC Identity Cards & Smart Cards
- Material: High-grade PVC / Polycarbonate composite.
- Card Dimensions: Standard CR80 format (85.6mm x 54mm x 0.76mm / 30 mil thickness).
- Printing Techniques: High-definition digital thermal re-transfer, UV flatbed printing, and industrial offset printing with protective gloss or matte lamination overlay.
- Security Features: Hologram hot-stamping, UV invisible ink, guilloche background patterns, micro-text, QR codes, sequential numbering, and barcode encoding (Code 128, Code 39, QR).
- Card Types:
  - School & College Student ID Cards (Single / Both side print)
  - Corporate & Employee Identity Cards
  - Visitor & Contractor Passes
  - Membership & Loyalty Cards
  - RFID Smart Cards (13.56 MHz Mifare 1K/4K, NTAG)
  - Proximity EM Cards (125 kHz EM4100 / TK4100)

### B. Custom Lanyards (Neck Ribbons)
- Materials: Fine polyester, satin ribbon, woven nylon.
- Standard Widths: 12mm, 16mm, 20mm, 25mm.
- Printing Options:
  - Multi-Color Sublimation (Heat Transfer): Vivid full-color gradients, photographs, and precise logo reproduction.
  - Screen Printing: Sharp solid-color printing on dyed polyester ribbons.
  - Jacquard / Woven: Logo and text woven directly into fabric for long lifespan.
- Attachments & Fittings:
  - Metal dog-hook (swivel hook)
  - Fish hook / Trigger clip
  - Alligator clip
  - Plastic quick-release buckle
  - Safety breakaway neck clip (for schools and hazardous factory environments)

### C. ID Card Holders & Pouches
- Hard Plastic Holders: Single-sided and dual-sided rigid ABS card cases in portrait and landscape orientations.
- Soft Vinyl Pouches: Clear waterproof PVC pouches for conferences, exhibitions, and visitor badges.
- Colored Frames: Available in blue, black, white, red, green, and custom pantone shades.

### D. Badges & Attachments
- Magnetic Name Badges: Dual-magnet backing prevents puncture damage to fine shirts and suits.
- Pin-back Badges: Durable stainless steel pin backings.
- Event Rosettes: Satin ribbon rosettes for awards, celebrations, and sports events.
- Retractable YoYo Badge Reels: Heavy-duty cord mechanism for quick card swiping at security turnstiles.

## 2. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q: What is the turnaround time for bulk orders?
A: Standard production takes 3 to 7 working days depending on quantity, customization requirements, and print approvals.

Q: Can we print individual student or employee photos and data?
A: Yes, we provide full Variable Data Printing (VDP) from Excel sheets, including portraits, names, blood groups, addresses, and emergency contacts.

Q: Do you ship across India?
A: Yes, we provide reliable courier and logistics delivery to all states and union territories in India.
